metadata.title: Onshape Part Studio and Assembly coverage checklist
metadata.source_scope: Only committed next/ at the pinned commit; legacy src/, archive and private candidates do not count.
metadata.interpretation: Counts are inventory items, not completion percentages. No topic is certified for every documented Onshape option. Partial means identifiable code and bounded evidence, not complete or GUI accepted.
metadata.pending_candidates: AngleViaPoint/native axes and Pad/Pocket termination are pending review outside frozen baseline 15703c5; no candidate functionality counts as implemented or accepted here.
limits: Static inventory and existing-evidence audit only; no fresh native, GUI or resource acceptance.
All documented option requirements remain open. No completion percentage is inferred.
Only the pinned replacement next/ source counts. Legacy implementation and unreviewed candidates are excluded from completed functionality.
FreeCAD 1.1.4/Open CASCADE own geometry, solver, transactions and much reference behavior. Native limits and product deviations need explicit decisions.
Cloud document identity, version history, permissions, libraries, translation and collaboration remain open where required. Local file save and Undo do not establish these contracts.
Every topic must pass the applicable gates before full workflow acceptance. G1 remains an implementation comparison obligation, not proof of exhaustive behavioral parity.

bounded_correction.scope: Variable-name identity across tables; no new requirement or runtime acceptance.

acceptance_gates.G1: Review every documented desktop input, submode, selection type and dependency against an exact implementation. Record explicit native limits and agreed deviations.
acceptance_gates.G2: Actual editor creation and existing-feature editing, including conditional fields, units, expressions, manipulators and selection identities. A catalog entry is insufficient.
acceptance_gates.G3: Parent/reference/topology changes, moved coordinate frames, dependent recomputation and source isolation where required.
acceptance_gates.G4: Preview replacement, Cancel, invalid selection/value and solver failure recovery without unintended document or redo changes.
acceptance_gates.G5: Sketch-action and document Undo/Redo, Finish validation and Cancel on consumed profiles where applicable.
acceptance_gates.G6: Save to new native files, reopen in editor and independent native inspection of editable graph, exact links, constraints and analytical/authoritative geometry.
acceptance_gates.G7: Original/source file hash preservation, cross-platform behavior and representative native-baseline comparison. Report unsupported native cases rather than inventing success.
acceptance_gates.G8: Representative resource regression and reliability checks for the completed workflow. Keep quiescent resource facts separate from interaction latency and speed claims.

implementation_backlog.name: Close shared modeling foundations
implementation_backlog.reason: Selection, units, sketch support, transactions and stable references affect every later feature. Finish existing pending GUI gates before broader parity claims.

implementation_backlog.name: Complete basic solid feature options
implementation_backlog.reason: Existing names and native forms cover useful subsets, but complete endpoint, region, orientation, pattern, merge and history behavior remains open.

implementation_backlog.name: Fill sketch authoring gaps
implementation_backlog.reason: Missing authoring modes and sketch editing/constraint tools are independent backlog items, not covered by similar geometry or manual workarounds.

implementation_backlog.name: Complete direct/surface/curve modeling
implementation_backlog.reason: Most dedicated operations are absent from the replacement catalog and editor.

implementation_backlog.name: Add parametric data, evaluation and configurations
implementation_backlog.reason: Mass/materials, measurement, tolerances, variants and reusable variables are essential part/assembly workflows.

implementation_backlog.name: Implement complete assembly foundation and motion
implementation_backlog.reason: next/ has Body placements and containers but no replacement component-instance graph, mate solver or assembly authoring system. Legacy assembly code is not counted.

implementation_backlog.name: Add frames, sheet metal and flexible PCB
implementation_backlog.reason: These are explicit Part Studio tools and remain entirely visible in the requested scope.

implementation_backlog.name: Complete shared views, interchange and service-dependent workflows
implementation_backlog.reason: Do not silently omit documented shared/cloud/platform requirements; choose compatible local behavior or an explicit product decision.

implementation_backlog.name: Implement persistent history and broken-reference repair
implementation_backlog.reason: A native Undo stack is not persistent version, context or graphical repair parity. Define local/cloud history and identity contracts.

implementation_backlog.name: Resolve document organization and collaboration contracts
implementation_backlog.reason: Keep document browsing, permissions, live collaboration and optional cloud capabilities visible; deferred service decisions remain open.
